sentences.text: Mr.Joshi, learned APP waives service of notice of Rule on behalf of respondent State.

1. The applicant has filed this bail Application under Section 439 of the CRPC for enlarging the applicant on Regular Bail in connection with FIR being C.R.No.I- 11193004220282 of 2022 registered with Amreli Rural Police Station, Dist.Amreli for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 363, 367, 323 and 506(2) of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 of the POCSO Act.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/13276/2024 ORDER DATED: 15/07/2024 undefined
2. Heard learned advocate Mr.Bhavin Thakkar for the applicant.
He submitted that in the present offence the investigation is over and the charge-sheet is filed.
The present applicant has been falsely implicated in the present offence.

The applicant has been arrested in offence in question since long Vashrambhai @ Visu Arjanbhai Dabhi vs State Of Gujarat on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151616591/
1 and since then he is in custody.

sentences.text: He submitted that the applicant shall abide by all the conditions that may be imposed by this Court while ordering him to be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned APP Soaham Joshi opposed the bail contending that there are serious allegations against the present application.
He, therefore, submitted to dismiss the present application.

4. Heard learned advocate for the parties and perused the record.
5.

From the record it appears that the present applicant had abducted the son of the first informant who was aged about 3 years at the time of incident and had taken him to his own house and when the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/13276/2024 ORDER DATED: 15/07/2024 undefined first informant came in search of his son to his house, he found that the victim was present in the house of the present applicant and the applicant had undressed the victim and the applicant had imposed himself over the body of the victim and had also made the victim take his private part in his mouth.

Having regard to the allegations made against the present applicant and also the material collected during the investigation against the present applicant, no case is made out and hence the present application is dismissed.
